notes.A: The close-up reveals rats on the counter and crops away almost the entire yard.
notes.B: The lamp dominates the foreground, drawing attention away from the patron and serving window.
notes.C: The high angle maps the courtyard, with the tower swallowing much of the view.
notes.D: The sign and checkerboard interior identify the snack bar, while the framing loses the courtyard.
notes.E: Tables, a lamp and two figures show courtyard life. The snack bar is clipped.
notes.F: The shop, tables and lamp read clearly. A blank passage wall dominates the left.
notes.G: The serving window and tables establish the courtyard’s purpose. The tower crowds the right.
notes.H: The passage and tower frame the yard. Empty paving makes the snack bar feel distant.

works_yard.best: The Rat Dogs window, tables, lamp and robed figures give the yard character, and the round tower anchors it.
works_yard.lacks: The courtyard lacks a focal point. Its serving hatch is easy to miss amid repeated windows, dark paving and scattered tables.
works_yard.fix: Extend the Rat Dogs counter into the yard beneath a brightly lit awning so the snack bar becomes the courtyard’s focal point.

blind_name.name: Cobblestone courtyard
blind_name.why: A lamppost and two stools stand on cobblestones between brick and stone buildings.
blind_name.odd: Deep shadows obscure the passage behind the lamppost.

notes.A: The counter and street creature share the frame, but the creature is squeezed against the edge.
notes.B: Tables and a metal door establish the layout, but the cleaver is clipped.
notes.C: Stools and rats line the counter, but the near wall takes up a third.
notes.D: The cleaver, rats, and seating read clearly, but the gray door pulls attention away.
notes.E: The cleaver and rats tell the story beside the street opening, but seating disappears.
notes.F: The counter, seats, and hanging pans establish the diner, though foreground stools are cut off.
notes.G: Tables and the counter establish the room, but a long blank wall dominates.
notes.H: The rat and handwashing sign make a good joke, but the close-up hides the layout.

ratdogs.best: F shows the rat-strewn counter, stools, checkerboard dining area, and kitchen signs together, making the diner’s identity clear.
ratdogs.lacks: The diner has no visible cooking station to connect the rats and cleaver to what’s being served.
ratdogs.fix: Build a greasy griddle behind the counter with rat skewers visibly cooking on it.

blind_name.name: Bar interior
blind_name.why: A long wooden counter, red bar stools, and round pedestal tables sit on a checkered floor.
blind_name.odd: The small objects on the counter are hard to identify.
